metadata.title: Auto Loan Payment - Fixed-Rate Estimator
metadata.description: Fixed-rate auto loan estimator with TILA-aligned disclosures, APR governance, and total cost of ownership modeling.

outputs.label: Financed amount
outputs.expression: max(vehiclePrice - downPayment - (tradeInValue - amountOwedOnTrade), 0) + dealerFees + registrationFees + extendedWarrantyCost + (max(vehiclePrice - downPayment - (tradeInValue - amountOwedOnTrade), 0) * salesTaxRate / 100)

outputs.label: Periodic payment
outputs.expression: ((useCreditTier > 0 ? annualPercentageRate * creditScore : annualPercentageRate) / 100 / paymentsPerYear) === 0 ? (max(vehiclePrice - downPayment - (tradeInValue - amountOwedOnTrade), 0) + dealerFees + registrationFees + extendedWarrantyCost + (max(vehiclePrice - downPayment - (tradeInValue - amountOwedOnTrade), 0) * salesTaxRate / 100)) / (termMonths / 12 * paymentsPerYear) : (((useCreditTier > 0 ? annualPercentageRate * creditScore : annualPercentageRate) / 100 / paymentsPerYear) * (max(vehiclePrice - downPayment - (tradeInValue - amountOwedOnTrade), 0) + dealerFees + registrationFees + extendedWarrantyCost + (max(vehiclePrice - downPayment - (tradeInValue - amountOwedOnTrade), 0) * salesTaxRate / 100))) / (1 - pow(1 + (useCreditTier > 0 ? annualPercentageRate * creditScore : annualPercentageRate) / 100 / paymentsPerYear, -(termMonths / 12 * paymentsPerYear)))

outputs.label: Total of all payments
outputs.expression: ((((useCreditTier > 0 ? annualPercentageRate * creditScore : annualPercentageRate) / 100 / paymentsPerYear) === 0 ? (max(vehiclePrice - downPayment - (tradeInValue - amountOwedOnTrade), 0) + dealerFees + registrationFees + extendedWarrantyCost + (max(vehiclePrice - downPayment - (tradeInValue - amountOwedOnTrade), 0) * salesTaxRate / 100)) / (termMonths / 12 * paymentsPerYear) : (((useCreditTier > 0 ? annualPercentageRate * creditScore : annualPercentageRate) / 100 / paymentsPerYear) * (max(vehiclePrice - downPayment - (tradeInValue - amountOwedOnTrade), 0) + dealerFees + registrationFees + extendedWarrantyCost + (max(vehiclePrice - downPayment - (tradeInValue - amountOwedOnTrade), 0) * salesTaxRate / 100))) / (1 - pow(1 + (useCreditTier > 0 ? annualPercentageRate * creditScore : annualPercentageRate) / 100 / paymentsPerYear, -(termMonths / 12 * paymentsPerYear)))))) * (termMonths / 12 * paymentsPerYear)

outputs.label: Total interest paid
outputs.expression: ((((useCreditTier > 0 ? annualPercentageRate * creditScore : annualPercentageRate) / 100 / paymentsPerYear) === 0 ? (max(vehiclePrice - downPayment - (tradeInValue - amountOwedOnTrade), 0) + dealerFees + registrationFees + extendedWarrantyCost + (max(vehiclePrice - downPayment - (tradeInValue - amountOwedOnTrade), 0) * salesTaxRate / 100)) / (termMonths / 12 * paymentsPerYear) : (((useCreditTier > 0 ? annualPercentageRate * creditScore : annualPercentageRate) / 100 / paymentsPerYear) * (max(vehiclePrice - downPayment - (tradeInValue - amountOwedOnTrade), 0) + dealerFees + registrationFees + extendedWarrantyCost + (max(vehiclePrice - downPayment - (tradeInValue - amountOwedOnTrade), 0) * salesTaxRate / 100))) / (1 - pow(1 + (useCreditTier > 0 ? annualPercentageRate * creditScore : annualPercentageRate) / 100 / paymentsPerYear, -(termMonths / 12 * paymentsPerYear)))))) * (termMonths / 12 * paymentsPerYear) - (max(vehiclePrice - downPayment - (tradeInValue - amountOwedOnTrade), 0) + dealerFees + registrationFees + extendedWarrantyCost + (max(vehiclePrice - downPayment - (tradeInValue - amountOwedOnTrade), 0) * salesTaxRate / 100))

outputs.label: Total cost of ownership
outputs.expression: ((((useCreditTier > 0 ? annualPercentageRate * creditScore : annualPercentageRate) / 100 / paymentsPerYear) === 0 ? (max(vehiclePrice - downPayment - (tradeInValue - amountOwedOnTrade), 0) + dealerFees + registrationFees + extendedWarrantyCost + (max(vehiclePrice - downPayment - (tradeInValue - amountOwedOnTrade), 0) * salesTaxRate / 100)) / (termMonths / 12 * paymentsPerYear) : (((useCreditTier > 0 ? annualPercentageRate * creditScore : annualPercentageRate) / 100 / paymentsPerYear) * (max(vehiclePrice - downPayment - (tradeInValue - amountOwedOnTrade), 0) + dealerFees + registrationFees + extendedWarrantyCost + (max(vehiclePrice - downPayment - (tradeInValue - amountOwedOnTrade), 0) * salesTaxRate / 100))) / (1 - pow(1 + (useCreditTier > 0 ? annualPercentageRate * creditScore : annualPercentageRate) / 100 / paymentsPerYear, -(termMonths / 12 * paymentsPerYear)))))) * (termMonths / 12 * paymentsPerYear) + downPayment + max(tradeInValue, 0) + ((annualInsurance + annualMaintenance + annualFuel) * (termMonths / 12))

fields.label: Vehicle price before tax
fields.helpText: Use the negotiated vehicle price before tax and fees.
fields.ariaLabel: Enter the vehicle price before tax in US dollars.
fields.errorMessage: Vehicle price must be zero or greater.
fields.helpTooltip: The sticker or negotiated price before tax, fees, or trade-in adjustments.

fields.label: Down payment
fields.helpText: Cash paid upfront that reduces the amount financed.
fields.ariaLabel: Enter the down payment in US dollars.
fields.errorMessage: Down payment must be zero or greater.
fields.helpTooltip: Cash, rebates, or credits applied at closing that reduce the financed balance.

fields.label: Trade-in value
fields.helpText: Estimated value of the vehicle you trade in.
fields.ariaLabel: Enter the trade-in value in US dollars.
fields.errorMessage: Trade-in value must be zero or greater.
fields.helpTooltip: The market value of your current vehicle applied as a credit.

fields.label: Amount owed on trade-in
fields.helpText: Balance remaining on your current auto loan.
fields.ariaLabel: Enter the amount owed on your trade-in in US dollars.
fields.errorMessage: Amount owed must be zero or greater.
fields.helpTooltip: If this exceeds the trade-in value, negative equity is rolled into the new loan.

fields.label: Sales tax rate
fields.helpText: Use the applicable sales tax rate for your jurisdiction.
fields.ariaLabel: Enter the sales tax rate as a percentage.
fields.errorMessage: Sales tax rate must be between 0 and 25 percent.
fields.helpTooltip: Some states tax the full price or apply trade-in credits differently.

fields.label: ZIP code for tax lookup
fields.helpText: Optional. Use when local tax lookup is available.
fields.ariaLabel: Enter a five-digit ZIP code for tax lookup.
fields.errorMessage: ZIP code must be a valid five-digit number.
fields.helpTooltip: Use to prefill sales tax if a live tax data source is connected.

fields.label: Dealer fees
fields.helpText: Documentation, processing, and dealer add-on fees.
fields.ariaLabel: Enter dealer fees in US dollars.
fields.errorMessage: Dealer fees must be zero or greater.
fields.helpTooltip: Commonly includes documentation and processing fees.

fields.label: Registration and title fees
fields.helpText: State title, registration, and mandatory filing fees.
fields.ariaLabel: Enter registration and title fees in US dollars.
fields.errorMessage: Registration fees must be zero or greater.
fields.helpTooltip: Includes DMV filing, title, and plate fees when applicable.

fields.label: Extended warranty or service contract
fields.helpText: Optional service contracts financed with the loan.
fields.ariaLabel: Enter extended warranty cost in US dollars.
fields.errorMessage: Warranty cost must be zero or greater.
fields.helpTooltip: Only include if rolled into the financed amount.

fields.label: Annual Percentage Rate (APR)
fields.helpText: APR includes certain finance charges and is not the same as the interest rate.
fields.ariaLabel: Enter the Annual Percentage Rate as a percent.
fields.errorMessage: APR must be between 0 and 36 percent.
fields.helpTooltip: APR reflects the cost of credit over a year, including eligible finance charges.

fields.label: Credit score tier
fields.helpText: Select a tier to apply a 2026 market multiplier to the APR.
fields.helpTooltip: Multipliers adjust the base APR to reflect credit risk tiers.

fields.label: Use credit tier multiplier
fields.helpText: Choose Yes to apply the credit tier multiplier to APR.
fields.helpTooltip: Use this when you want to adjust APR by credit tier.

fields.label: Loan term in months
fields.helpText: Common terms range from 24 to 84 months.
fields.ariaLabel: Enter the loan term in months.
fields.errorMessage: Loan term must be between 12 and 96 months.
fields.helpTooltip: The total number of months used to amortize the loan.

fields.label: Payments per year
fields.helpText: Monthly is 12. Biweekly is 26. Weekly is 52.
fields.ariaLabel: Enter the number of payments per year.
fields.errorMessage: Payments per year must be between 1 and 52.
fields.helpTooltip: Defines payment frequency for the amortization schedule.

fields.label: Annual insurance cost
fields.helpText: Optional running cost used in total cost of ownership.
fields.ariaLabel: Enter annual insurance cost in US dollars.
fields.errorMessage: Annual insurance cost must be zero or greater.
fields.helpTooltip: Estimate yearly insurance premium for the vehicle.

fields.label: Annual maintenance cost
fields.helpText: Optional running cost for service and repairs.
fields.ariaLabel: Enter annual maintenance cost in US dollars.
fields.errorMessage: Annual maintenance cost must be zero or greater.
fields.helpTooltip: Estimate planned maintenance and expected repairs annually.

fields.label: Annual fuel or energy cost
fields.helpText: Optional running cost to model fuel or charging.
fields.ariaLabel: Enter annual fuel or energy cost in US dollars.
fields.errorMessage: Annual fuel cost must be zero or greater.
fields.helpTooltip: Use estimated annual fuel or electricity expense.

introduction: Regulation Z oriented fixed-rate auto loan estimator with negative equity, fee, and tax handling.
Outputs include financed amount, payment schedule, and total cost of ownership signals.
methodology: Amortization uses a level-payment fixed-rate formula with deterministic rounding at the display layer.
how_is_calculated: Taxable base equals vehicle price minus down payment minus net trade-in equity.
Financed amount includes taxable base, dealer fees, registration, optional warranty, and sales tax.
Payment uses APR and payment frequency with a zero-rate fallback.
Total cost of ownership adds operating costs and up-front outlays.
APR selection is governed by the credit tier toggle and manual override.
examples: Example: $30,000 price, $3,000 down, $0 trade-in, 8% tax, $0 fees, 5% APR, 60 months: payment and totals are estimates only.

faqs.question: How is negative equity handled?
faqs.answer: Negative equity equals amount owed on trade-in minus trade-in value and increases the financed amount.

faqs.question: Why do APR and interest rate differ?
faqs.answer: APR reflects the cost of credit and can include certain finance charges, while the interest rate reflects the base cost of borrowing.

faqs.question: Does this replace lender disclosures?
faqs.answer: No. Final lender disclosures control and may differ due to lender-specific fees or timing.

glossary.definition: Annual Percentage Rate as defined by Regulation Z, reflecting the cost of credit over a year.
The amount owed on a trade-in that exceeds its value.
Loan payments plus out-of-pocket and operating costs across the selected term.

legalDisclosures: Interest rate is the nominal cost of borrowing. APR includes certain finance charges and may differ from the interest rate.
APR calculations are governed by Regulation Z and Appendix J for closed-end credit. Lender disclosures control.
This tool provides estimates for planning and comparison. It does not constitute a credit offer.

inputs.tradeInValue: If provided, reduces the taxable base and financed amount.
inputs.amountOwedOnTrade: Negative equity rolls into the financed amount.
inputs.creditScore: Credit tier multiplier applied to the base APR.
inputs.salesTaxRate: Apply jurisdictional tax to the taxable base.
inputs.dealerFees: Out-the-door costs that may be financed.

limitations.jurisdiction: Tax treatment varies by state and dealer; verify local rules.
limitations.fees: Some fees may be excluded from APR or handled differently by lenders.
limitations.rounding: Display rounding is applied for readability and may differ from lender statements.
